description: This file defines the MiniLangElement class, a superclass for all XML element models in the Mini-language framework of the OFBiz project. It includes methods for handling XML elements, logging, and artifact info gathering.

classes.name: MiniLangElement
classes.description: Superclass for all XML element models in the Mini-language, providing common functionality such as artifact info gathering, trace logging, and access to element properties.

methods.name: MiniLangElement
methods.description: Constructor initializing the element with an XML Element and a SimpleMethod reference.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to update artifact info context with this element's data.

methods.name: getLineNumber
methods.description: Returns the source code line number associated with this element, or 'unknown' if not available.

methods.name: getSimpleMethod
methods.description: Returns the SimpleMethod object associated with this element.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Returns the tag name of the XML element.

methods.name: outputTraceMessage
methods.description: Logs a trace message with details about the element and provided messages.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the element in XML tag format.
